title: Glowing palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='trunk' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8a5a2b'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#c98a4b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#7a4a20'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f5d98a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d9b45c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sand island -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='8' fill='url(#sand)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#ffeaa8'/>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <path d='M46 86 Q48 60 50 48 Q52 60 54 86 Z' fill='url(#trunk)'/>
  <path d='M47.5 84 L49 50 L50 49 L50 84 Z' fill='#e0a763' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- coconuts -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#6b4a1f'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='47' r='3' fill='#7d5527'/>
  <!-- fronds, each a distinct bright green -->
  <path d='M50 47 Q30 30 18 38 Q34 36 50 47 Z' fill='#3fd97a'/>
  <path d='M50 47 Q34 22 22 20 Q36 28 50 47 Z' fill='#57e88f'/>
  <path d='M50 47 Q48 18 38 10 Q48 26 50 47 Z' fill='#35c46c'/>
  <path d='M50 47 Q60 16 72 12 Q60 26 50 47 Z' fill='#6cf0a0'/>
  <path d='M50 47 Q72 26 82 30 Q68 34 50 47 Z' fill='#45d982'/>
  <path d='M50 47 Q72 46 82 56 Q66 52 50 47 Z' fill='#2fb85f'/>
  <!-- glow highlights on fronds -->
  <path d='M40 34 Q44 32 47 36' stroke='#b5ffd0' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 32 Q64 28 68 20' stroke='#c8ffe0' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 50 Q72 50 78 54' stroke='#9cffc0' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
